bad.subject: Generate ETags for all request responses

outcome.failureOutput: WHOBROKEIT_BUG: expected the mounted app to inherit "trust proxy" = true, but got false (foobarquux = true)

explanation.why: In `lib/application.js`, `defaultConfiguration` now calls `this.set('trust proxy', false)`. That call stores `trust proxy` and the derived `trust proxy fn` as own properties of every app's `settings`, including the sub-app's. When the sub-app is mounted, its `settings.__proto__` is pointed at the parent's settings. The sub-app's own `false` values shadow the parent's `true`, so `subApp.get('trust proxy')` returns false. Before this commit nothing set a default, so the lookup fell through to the parent.
